ValidationRule.description: This validation rule does not allow a user with Marketing user profile to change Lead status to converted.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( NOT($Setup.PMC_ProcessSwitches__c.PMC_BypassValidationRule__c) , $Profile.Name = 'PMC Marketing User' , ISCHANGED( Status ) , ISPICKVAL( Status , 'Converted') )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Marketing Users are not able to convert Leads
